title: The Secret Organization
summary: Evading Bureau attack helicopters in subterranean Yeouido tunnels, Min-Jae hacks a downed scout drone and uncovers the Demon Hunter Bureau's dark global syndicate.

panels.action: Colossal concrete stormwater tunnels stretching into darkness, water rushing beneath rusted cat-walks.
panels.prose_en: Colossal concrete stormwater tunnels stretching into darkness, water rushing beneath rusted cat-walks.
panels.prose_hi: Andhere mein faili vishal concrete toofani surangen, jung lage cat-vock ke neeche bahta pani.

panels.shot: min-jae setting down black drone wreckage
panels.action: Min-Jae drops the smoking chassis of a downed Hunter Bureau scout drone onto a metal workstation.
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae drops the smoking chassis of a downed Hunter Bureau scout drone onto a metal workstation.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ek giraye gaye hunter bureau scout drone ki smoking chesis ko ek metal workstation par gira deta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun watches calmly, his black jacket dusted with limestone and his eyes glowing dual crimson-violet.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Is drone mein se kuch data recover ho sakta hai, Min-Jae?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun watches calmly, his black jacket dusted with limestone and his eyes glowing dual crimson-violet.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun shanti se dekhta hai, uski kali jacket chuna patthar se sunny hui hai aur uski aankhen dohri lal-bangni chamak rahi han.

panels.action: Min-Jae plugs a glowing blue fiber-optic interface cable directly into the drone's shattered optical core.
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae plugs a glowing blue fiber-optic interface cable directly into the drone's shattered optical core.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ek chamakti neeli fiber-optic interface cable ko sidhe drone ke toote hue optical core mein plug karta hai.

panels.shot: kuro perched on rusted pipe overhead
panels.action: Kuro looks down with glowing red eyes: 'Insaano ne humare mana ko copy karne ki koshish ki hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Yeh technology ordinary military ki nahi hai. Isme artificial demon cores lage hain.

panels.prose_en: Kuro looks down with glowing red eyes: 'Insaano ne humare mana ko copy karne ki koshish ki hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro chamakti lal aankhon se neeche dekhta hai: 'insanon ne hamare man ko copy karne ki koshish ki hai.'

panels.action: Three concentric red digital security locks flash on Min-Jae's display: 'LEVEL-9 BUREAU CIPHER'.
panels.prose_en: Three concentric red digital security locks flash on Min-Jae's display: 'LEVEL-9 BUREAU CIPHER'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ke display par teen sankendrit lal digital suraksha taale chamakte han: 'leval-9 bureau sifar'.

panels.shot: ha-jun tapping ring finger on screen edge
panels.action: Ha-Jun touches the bezel of the laptop with his Ring of Hollow Blood; a thin spark of violet mana conducts into the circuitry.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun touches the bezel of the laptop with his Ring of Hollow Blood; a thin spark of violet mana conducts into the circuitry.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni ring off hollow blood se laptop ke bezal ko chhuta hai; baingani man ki ek patli chingari sarkitory mein pravahit hoti hai.

panels.action: The red security locks shatter into green cascades of decrypted code: 'ACCESS GRANTED: SECTOR 4 ARCHIVE'.

dialogue.text:
[SECURITY OVERRIDE DETECTED]
Identity: UNREGISTERED SOVEREIGN FREQUENCY
Clearance: DIRECTOR-LEVEL ACCESS UNLOCKED

panels.prose_en: The red security locks shatter into green cascades of decrypted code: 'ACCESS GRANTED: SECTOR 4 ARCHIVE'.
panels.prose_hi: Lal suraksha taale decripted code ke hare jharnon mein bikhar jaate han: 'pahunch di gai: sector 4 puralekh'.

panels.action: Min-Jae pushes up his glasses, staring in utter shock: 'Tumhare blood mana ne 256-bit quantum cipher tod diya?!'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Yeh cipher insaani computer se kabhi nahi toot sakta tha... Tumne kaise kiya?!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae pushes up his glasses, staring in utter shock: 'Tumhare blood mana ne 256-bit quantum cipher tod diya?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne apna chashma upar kiya aur ekdum sadme mein ghurte hue kaha: 'tumhare khoon man ne 256-bit quantum sifar tod diya?!'

panels.action: Ha-Jun glances at the obsidian ring: 'Yeh ring energy frequencies ko read aur bend karti hai.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Khoon sirf fluid nahi hai... Yeh information aur will ka carrier hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun glances at the obsidian ring: 'Yeh ring energy frequencies ko read aur bend karti hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun obsidian ring par nazar dalta hai: 'ye ring energy frequancy ko padhta aur modata hai.'

panels.action: A glowing holographic globe projects into the air, revealing a clandestine global network of hunter bases.
panels.prose_en: A glowing holographic globe projects into the air, revealing a clandestine global network of hunter bases.
panels.prose_hi: Ek chamakta hua holographic globe hawa mein prakshepit hota hai, jo shikari thikanon ke ek gupt vaishvik network ka khulasa karta hai.

panels.action: A black shield emblem with two crossed silver blades and a chained demon skull: 'GLOBAL DEMON HUNTER BUREAU'.
panels.prose_en: A black shield emblem with two crossed silver blades and a chained demon skull: 'GLOBAL DEMON HUNTER BUREAU'.
panels.prose_hi: Do paar kiye gaye chandi ke blade aur ek janjeer se bandhi danav khopdi ke saath ek kali dhal ka pratik: 'global demon hunter buro'.

panels.action: Trillions of won funneled from pharmaceutical conglomerates and private defense contractors into black-budget research.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Yeh koi government organization nahi hai... Yeh ek private shadow army hai!

panels.prose_en: Trillions of won funneled from pharmaceutical conglomerates and private defense contractors into black-budget research.
panels.prose_hi: Formaceutical samuhon aur niji raksha thekedaron se black-bajat anusandhan mein kharbon dollar kharch kiye gaye.

panels.action: Detailed blueprints show human soldiers augmented with synthetic demon tendons and mana-infused spinal implants.
panels.prose_en: Detailed blueprints show human soldiers augmented with synthetic demon tendons and mana-infused spinal implants.
panels.prose_hi: Vistrit blueprint mein manav sainikon ko synthetic danav tendon aur mana-infused spinal pratyaropan ke saath sanvardhit dikhaya gaya hai.

panels.action: Kuro spits a purple ember: 'Disgusting mortals. Humare bache hue corpses ko chop kar ke apne jism mein seal karte hain.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Inhe lagta hai ki Demon ban kar yeh Demons se lad sakte hain. Hypocrites!

panels.prose_en: Kuro spits a purple ember: 'Disgusting mortals. Humare bache hue corpses ko chop kar ke apne jism mein seal karte hain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne baingani rang ka angara ugla: 'ghrinit nashwar. hamare bacche hue laashon ko kaat kar apne jism mein seal lagate han.'

panels.action: A flashing crimson tab labelled 'PROJECT CHIMERA: SPECIMEN LOGS' appears on screen.
panels.prose_en: A flashing crimson tab labelled 'PROJECT CHIMERA: SPECIMEN LOGS' appears on screen.
panels.prose_hi: 'project chimera: specimen logs' label wala ek chamakta hua crimson tab screen par dikhai deta hai.

panels.action: Dozens of redacted subject folders dating back 20 years, categorized by genetic purity ratings.
panels.prose_en: Dozens of redacted subject folders dating back 20 years, categorized by genetic purity ratings.
panels.prose_hi: Aanuvanshik shuddhata rating ke aadhar par vargikrit 20 varsh purane darjanon sanshodhit vishay folder.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes widening in sudden realization
panels.action: Ha-Jun's breath catches in his throat as a familiar surname flashes in the directory.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's breath catches in his throat as a familiar surname flashes in the directory.
panels.prose_hi: Nirdeshika mein ek parichit upnaam chamakte hi ha-jun ki saansein atak jaati han.

panels.action: Folder icon reading: 'SUBJECT #009: KANG TAE-JUN (SECTOR 4 CAPTURE - YEAR 2019)'.

dialogue.text: SUBJECT #009: KANG TAE-JUN — FIRST BLOODLINE CARRIER DETECTED.

panels.prose_en: Folder icon reading: 'SUBJECT #009: KANG TAE-JUN (SECTOR 4 CAPTURE - YEAR 2019)'.
panels.prose_hi: Folder icon reding: 'vishay #009: kang taaye-jun (secter 4 capture - varsh 2019)'.

panels.shot: ha-jun gripping laptop screen border with force
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingers dig into the plastic casing, cracking the bezel as violent emotion surges.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's fingers dig into the plastic casing, cracking the bezel as violent emotion surges.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki ungaliyan plastic ke aavaran mein ghus jaati han, jisse hinsak bhavnaen badhne par bezal toot jata hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae steadies Ha-Jun's trembling arm: 'Shaant raho, Ha-Jun! Screen toot jayegi!'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: File open ho rahi hai... Dekho andar kya hai!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae steadies Ha-Jun's trembling arm: 'Shaant raho, Ha-Jun! Screen toot jayegi!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne ha-jun ki kampati bhuja ko sthir kiya: 'shant raho, ha-jun! screen toot jaegi!'.

panels.action: A faded identification photo of 19yo Kang Tae-Jun, with fierce dark eyes and a protective, gentle smile.
panels.prose_en: A faded identification photo of 19yo Kang Tae-Jun, with fierce dark eyes and a protective, gentle smile.
panels.prose_hi: Bhayankar kali aankhon aur ek surakshatmak, saumya muskan ke saath 19 varshiya kang taaye-jun ki ek dhundhli pehchan wali tasweer.

panels.action: Text document reading: 'Subject demonstrates high affinity for Sovereign Relic Resonance. Relic transfer attempted.'
panels.prose_en: Text document reading: 'Subject demonstrates high affinity for Sovereign Relic Resonance. Relic transfer attempted.'.
panels.prose_hi: Path dastavej padhna: 'vishay sovereign avashesh anunaad ke liye uchch aakarshan darshata hai. avashesh sthanantaran ka prayas kiya gaya.'

panels.action: A bold crimson stamp across the bottom of the page: 'STATUS: TRANSFERRED TO SECTION 9 UNDERGROUND FACILITY'.
panels.prose_en: A bold crimson stamp across the bottom of the page: 'STATUS: TRANSFERRED TO SECTION 9 UNDERGROUND FACILITY'.
panels.prose_hi: Prishth ke neeche ek bold crimson stamp: 'sthiti: anubhag 9 bhumigat suvidha mein sthanantrit'.

panels.shot: ha-jun trembling with tears and wrath
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes burn with dual crimson rings, a single tear cutting through dust on his cheek.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Woh zinda hain... Bhai abhi bhi unke qaid mein zinda hain!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes burn with dual crimson rings, a single tear cutting through dust on his cheek.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki aankhen dohri lal rang ki chhallon se jal rahi han, ek aansu uske gaal par dhul ko cheer raha hai.

panels.action: Kuro folds his wings: 'Maine kaha tha na... Tae-Jun ne tumhare liye yeh qurbani di thi.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Usne Bureau ka saara dhyan apni taraf kheench liya taaki tum bache raho.

panels.prose_en: Kuro folds his wings: 'Maine kaha tha na... Tae-Jun ne tumhare liye yeh qurbani di thi.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apne pankh mod leta hai: 'maine kaha tha na... taaye-jun ne tumhare liye yeh kurbani di thi...'.

panels.shot: sudden proximity alarm buzzing on laptop
panels.action: The laptop screen flashes violently with red radar pings: 'BREACH DETECTED: 50 METERS'.
panels.prose_en: The laptop screen flashes violently with red radar pings: 'BREACH DETECTED: 50 METERS'.
panels.prose_hi: Laptop screen lal radar ping ke saath tivrata se chamakti hai: 'ullanghan ka pata chala: 50 meter'.

panels.action: Min-Jae gasps: 'Unhone drone ke emergency beacon se humein locate kar liya!'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Unhone trace kar liya! Wahan dekho!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae gasps: 'Unhone drone ke emergency beacon se humein locate kar liya!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je haanfte hue kahte han: 'dron ke emergency bikan se humne locate kar liya!'.

panels.shot: three laser designator dots hitting ha-jun chest
panels.action: Three infrared red laser sniper dots converge dead-center over the Sovereign Crest on Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_en: Three infrared red laser sniper dots converge dead-center over the Sovereign Crest on Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_hi: Teen avarakt lal laser sniper dots ha-jun ki chhati par sovereign crest ke upar mrit-kendra mein ekatrit hote han.

panels.shot: ha-jun staring into darkness with cold predator eyes
panels.action: Ha-Jun doesn't flinch; his violet-crimson eyes ignite with lethal intent: 'Bohot accha hua ki woh aa gaye.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mujhe unke Director ka pata chahiye... Aur yeh mujhe bata kar rahenge.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun doesn't flinch; his violet-crimson eyes ignite with lethal intent: 'Bohot accha hua ki woh aa gaye.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun nahin ghabrata; uski bangni-lal aankhen ghatak iraade se chamakti han: 'bahut acha hua ki woh aa gaye.'
